· Below SMA100 (280,771 KRW), above SMA200 (228,770 KRW): neutral mid-to-long-term trend strength.

[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (52.2 → 49.4): continued consolidation in neutral range.
· MACD histogram trajectory (1356.5256 → -172.6935): improving, but no confirmed bearish reversal signal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (mid-band 266,850 KRW): band width at 14.54%, indicating moderate volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support (246,000 KRW): based on 20-day low.
· Swing resistance (267,000 KRW): based on SMA20, potential for short-term bullish transition upon breakout.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Higher Low): recovery signal being confirmed.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.58x): subdued volume reduces confidence in trend reversal.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase): conditions for observation met, entry for buy/sell after trend confirmation.
